clues.text: Leah named her third son this, hoping her husband Jacob would at last become attached to her.
With his brother Simeon, he took a sword into Shechem and killed its men to avenge their sister Dinah.
Among the sons of Jacob who went down to Egypt, this one fathered Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
In Egypt, the parents of the baby Moses, hidden in a basket by the Nile, both came from this family line.
When twelve tribal staffs were placed in the Tent of Meeting, this tribe's staff, bearing Aaron's name, sprouted almonds.
In the wilderness, the LORD set this tribe apart to carry the ark of the covenant and pronounce blessings.
When Moses gave out land to Israel's tribes, this tribe got no territory, for the LORD was its inheritance.

taken: Twelve were placed before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony, and Aaron's sprouted, blossomed and produced almonds overnight.
